scenarios.title: Retain rejected cue direction across owned relaunches
plannedActions: Save YAM MAN sentinel; import generation-review fixture under Synthetic cue recovery title.
Wait public snapshot for mounted editable generation-optional-direction, then reveal its hittable control and enter 29,999 x characters plus 🎬 once. Await exact canonical refusal.
Relaunch owned persistent session twice; use normal Projects browser to open target each time.
Replace text with Café 🎬 recovery corrected; await persistence and cleared recovery status; relaunch and reopen once more.
Close owned session in finally; preserve synthetic workspace.
expectedOutcomes: Exact 30,001 UTF-16-unit text and refusal appear while complete loaded and both saved models remain unchanged.
Two cold opens preserve exact journal bytes and revision and reproduce refusal without provider jobs or alerts.
Correction changes only prompt, one revision and modification date; journal clears after persistence.
Final cold open retains corrected model and empty recovery journal without provider jobs.
